pick.name: Apple Developer Program (defer until a paying need)
pick.what: Developer ID certs, notarization, App Store, TestFlight
pick.why: Mandatory for any iOS distribution and warning-free macOS apps; nothing to evaluate against

alts.name: Progressive web app (no Apple account)
alts.what: Ship the web app as a PWA installable on iOS/macOS
alts.why: Avoids the annual fee while validating demand
alts.free_limits: No App Store listing, limited native APIs

candidates.name: Apple Developer Enterprise Program
candidates.verdict: Internal distribution only; not for public apps

candidates.name: PWA / web app
candidates.verdict: No Apple fee but no App Store presence

decision: There is no alternative for the App Store or notarized macOS distribution; the decision is timing. Enrol when the first iOS/macOS customer is committed; cloud build services manage certificates without a Mac.
details: No free option: Apple charges US$99/yr for App Store distribution and notarization.

region_notes.India: Organization enrolment needs a D-U-N-S number; verify current local fee on the Apple page.

os_notes.macOS: Notarization requires Developer ID signing from the paid Apple Developer Program.
os_notes.Windows: iOS/macOS signing can be done through cloud build services without owning a Mac.
